settings.heading: 1. Cancellation Window
settings.text: You may cancel your order any time before it has been marked as fulfilled. Because we process orders within 1–2 business days, this generally gives you a window of up to 1–2 business days after placing your order to request a cancellation.

settings.heading: 2. How to Request a Cancellation
settings.text: To request a cancellation, email us at hello@somnasleep.com with the subject line "ORDER CANCELLATION - [Your Order Number]".

settings.heading: 3. Post-Processing Cancellations
settings.text: Once an order has been marked as fulfilled at our fulfillment center, it cannot be canceled or modified. If your cancellation request arrives after that point, the order will be shipped to you as placed.

settings.heading: 4. Returning an Uncanceled Order
settings.text: If you were unable to cancel your order in time, you may return the items in accordance with our Return & Refund Policy once you receive them. Please note that original shipping costs are non-refundable, and you will be responsible for return shipping fees.

settings.heading: 5. Somna's Right to Cancel
settings.text: We reserve the right to cancel any order at our sole discretion, including but not limited to situations involving suspected fraud, unauthorized or illegal transactions, pricing errors, or inventory shortages. If we cancel your order, you will be notified via email and fully refunded to your original payment method.
